parts.text: Radio coverage is patchy, especially around ports, industrial sites, and in bad weather, which causes reports from drones to arrive late, out of order, more than once, or not at all. Links used to give instructions to drones and charging equipment are also unreliable, so an instruction may get through twice without the sender knowing if the first attempt arrived. Furthermore, nobody watches every drone at every moment, and one person may be responsible for hundreds.
